title: Cozy and simple 1BR, Free Parking
description:
We are located 2.5 miles from downtown Nashville and close to TSU, The Nations, Sylvan Park and West End! Room has a detached full bathroom

You’re welcome to roam our backyard oasis, feed the chickens and even take some eggs if you’d like! We are a family of three  and also have a friendly pup, Lola. Happy to give any and all recommendations!

We look forward to hosting you :)
